[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Matthew was born 14 Oct 1842 in Plains, New Monkland, Scotland.  He was the son of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]].  

In 1851 Matthew was living at 37 Aitchison Street New Monkland with his parents, siblings and granny.<ref> (Scotland Census 1851; Parish: New Monkland; ED:8; Page:16; Line:14; Roll: cssct1851_170)</ref>

In 1861 Matthew was a coal miner living at 45 Aitchison Street New Monklands with his father and siblings.<ref> (Scotland Census 1861; Parish: new Monkland; ED:7; Page:11; Line:8; Roll:cssct1861_117)</ref>

He passed away 3 Nov 1914
